decisions.title: ghc-family-distributed-clock-contracts
decisions.trigger: Twenty local contracts passed owner validation before curation.
decisions.proposed_disposition: Install one new group skill and public TXT runner while retaining every local source.
decisions.compatibility_plan: Local source skills and runners remain unchanged and callable.
decisions.rollback: Use the retained local source entry point; preserve the additive curation for inspection.
decisions.evidence_needed: Official skill validation, exact byte parity, four accepting smokes, and one unsupported-operation refusal.
decisions.boundary: Same-owner synthetic integration evidence only. No external deployment, independent reproduction, scientific, professional, legal, cultural, Maori, affected-party, identity, complete privacy or accessibility, exhaustive security, production or Stage 20 credit. NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20.
